title: Statement of Purpose
intro: A short reflection on where I am heading, what I chose to put in this portfolio, and why those pieces matter.

sections.heading: My goals
sections.summary: Short-term and long-term, professional and academic.
sections.body:
PLACEHOLDER — replace this with your own writing.

Write about where you want to be in the next year or two: the kind of marketing internship or graduate role you are aiming for, and the specific skills you want to build (for example brand strategy, campaign analytics, or content production).

Then write about the longer term: the kind of marketer you want to become, the industry or type of organisation you want to work in, and any further study you are considering.

Be specific. "I want to work in marketing" says very little. "I want to work on brand campaigns for sustainable consumer goods, because…" says a lot.

sections.heading: Why these documents
sections.summary: The package I chose and what each piece is doing here.
sections.body:
PLACEHOLDER — replace this with your own writing.

Explain that you chose the Job Seeking package, and why that fits where you are right now rather than the Study Exchange route.

Then take each of the three documents in turn — your CV, your cover letter, and your LinkedIn profile — and say what each one is meant to show about you that the others do not. A grader is looking for evidence that you chose deliberately, not that you filled three slots.

Mention what changed between drafts, and what a piece of peer feedback made you rethink.

sections.heading: How this connects to my future
sections.summary: The link between these artifacts and where I am going.
sections.body:
PLACEHOLDER — replace this with your own writing.

Tie the two sections above together. How do these specific documents move you toward the goals you described? What will you do with them after this class — which roles will you actually apply to, and what still needs work before you do?

This is the reflective part, so it is fine to name a weakness. Writing "my CV still leans on coursework because I have limited industry experience, so my next step is…" reads as self-aware, not as a gap.
